address: V Community, 345/9 Mu 3, Wongwaen Rop 2 Road, San Phra Net, San Sai, Chiang Mai, 50210, Thailand
bio: Bearing a loose resemblance to San Francisco’s Golden Gate Bridge, the bridge in this restaurant’s name (which translates as 'delicious at the red bridge') forms an iconic landmark while also providing guests with a pleasant spot for dining after dark. The range of healthy Northern Thai dishes provides intense flavours; their biotechnology-derived fermented pork has the highest levels of hygiene and quality, and is used in many of the dishes....
